judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped mid-implementation (leaving `.lore/dod.md` checked only halfway through and an unwanted `registry.acceptance.test.ts` artifact). Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` is incomplete.
